Note: This article refers to a fictional digital conflict within an online group chat community, and is part of an internally constructed lore.
The Ogs Revolution was a three-day internal digital conflict within the **Homies Group Chat** (Homies GC), fought between the original members of the chat (referred to as the "OGs") and a newly formed alliance of recent entrants. The outcome was a decisive OG victory, resulting in the permanent expulsion of the newer factions.
Background
The Homies GC experienced a surge of new participants in early 2025, including the M3ntians, Abu Omarians, MDB members, Bronzians, and Mosaldians. While active, these groups clashed with the long-standing norms and leadership of the GC, which was historically governed by the OGs. Disputes over tone, etiquette, and content escalated by late April.
Conflict
On April 28, 2025, OG-aligned factions including the W6stians, Setians, Mohians, Ahmadians, Xrxosians, and Katians initiated a coordinated effort to remove the new member factions. Utilizing moderator tools, the OGs began systematically muting, kicking, and banning opposing users.
The new gens attempted to resist via mass messaging and organizing sympathetic replies, but lacked admin-level access. By April 30, the purge had concluded. Over 500,000 accounts were removed from message threads or muted, and over 230,000 banned from future entry.
Aftermath
The OGs restructured the chat’s permissions, centralized administrative control, and restricted future member invitations. The revolution effectively ended the influence of the M3ntian bloc and its allies within the GC.
Legacy
The Ogs Revolution is cited by veterans as a turning point in maintaining the identity and integrity of the Homies GC. It continues to influence how new users are vetted, and remains a touchstone in the group's internal history.
